title: The Faithfulness of God
definition: The faithfulness of God means that He always keeps His promises and remains true to His character.
summary: God does not abandon His Word, forget His covenant, or fail His people. His faithfulness stands firm through every generation.
christFocus: Every promise of God finds its ultimate fulfillment in Christ.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God does not abandon His Word, forget His covenant, or fail His people. His faithfulness stands firm through every generation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
